title: Historie
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the mid-4th century BC, as Philip II's Macedonia challenges Athens and Persia watches, a young man named Eumenes, who dresses like a barbarian but speaks fluent Greek, tries to cross the Hellespont and is drawn into the conflict; a long flashback tells his origins (Beneath the Tangles review). He will become a commander and secretary to Alexander the Great, rising by wit and talent rather than birth (K Manga blurb via AniList; MU).
life_message: Intelligence, curiosity and self-command let an outsider make his own place in a violent, rank-bound world.
